opportunities.title: The building blocks for a voice assistant exist
opportunities.detail: Commercial speech recognition and a synthetic voice both exist, but no major assistant understands spoken requests in this language yet.
opportunities.why: About 811 thousand Welsh speakers are online today. Ready to use: FLEURS (12 hours of transcribed speech); YODAS2 (6.3 hours of transcribed speech).

opportunities.title: No published LLM benchmark results
opportunities.detail: Neither of the two multilingual benchmarks we track reports this language. Adding it would give builders and buyers a baseline.
opportunities.why: About 811 thousand Welsh speakers are online and able to text today. Ready to use: FLORES-200 (covers this language); FineWeb-2 (523 million words).

opportunities.title: 1 of 2 major AI assistant apps list this language
opportunities.detail: Some assistant apps already offer it. Listing it would tell speakers they can rely on it.
opportunities.why: About 811 thousand Welsh speakers are online and able to text today. Ready to use: FLORES-200 (covers this language).

opportunities.title: No reading-comprehension benchmark
opportunities.detail: Belebele, the widest multilingual reading benchmark, doesn't include this language yet.
opportunities.why: About 811 thousand Welsh speakers are online and able to text today. Ready to use: FLORES-200 (covers this language).

opportunities.title: Text recognition is offered by 2 of 3 major services
opportunities.detail: Some services already read printed text in this language, and an open OCR model covers it.
opportunities.why: About 811 thousand Welsh speakers are online and able to text today. Ready to use: Tesseract OCR (covers this language); FineWeb-2 (523 million words).

opportunities.title: Predictive text and autocorrect could be built from open text
opportunities.detail: The iOS keyboard has 0 of 4 typing features. FineWeb-2 holds about 523 million words of openly licensed web text, enough to train word prediction.
opportunities.why: About 811 thousand Welsh speakers are online and able to text today. Ready to use: FineWeb-2 (523 million words); Wikipedia (285 thousand articles).

opportunities.title: The interface is translated on 2 of 3 major platforms
opportunities.detail: People can already use some phone and computer platforms in this language. Shared terminology would make the remaining ones faster to translate.
opportunities.why: About 811 thousand Welsh speakers are online and able to text today. Ready to use: Firefox localisation (Pontoon) (covers this language); Unicode CLDR (modern coverage).

opportunities.title: Speech input is offered by 3 of 4 major services
opportunities.detail: Some services already recognise this language. Open training data includes 142 hours of transcribed speech across 3 open datasets.
opportunities.why: About 811 thousand Welsh speakers are online today. Ready to use: FLEURS (12 hours of transcribed speech); YODAS2 (6.3 hours of transcribed speech).

opportunities.title: Speech recognition makes about 29 errors per 100 words
opportunities.detail: Measured on FLEURS with a leading open model. Below about 15% is comfortably usable for dictation.
opportunities.why: About 811 thousand Welsh speakers are online today. Ready to use: FLEURS (12 hours of transcribed speech); YODAS2 (6.3 hours of transcribed speech).

opportunities.title: Text-to-speech is offered by 2 of 3 major services
opportunities.detail: Some cloud services already have a voice for this language, and an open model can speak it.
opportunities.why: About 811 thousand Welsh speakers are online today. Ready to use: MMS text-to-speech (covers this language); FLEURS (12 hours of transcribed speech).
